## Open

### T-114 — Decide whether a dev deployment should name its semantic-log service

> _2026-09-18 · core/blong-realm · open_

Both regenerated artifacts name their caller by the service that emitted the record (D-216), and no
suite in this repo sets `log.service`, so the caller is the framework default `blong`. For
`realm/blong-gateway` that reads well: `blong->>gateway`, the framework process calling the gateway
namespace. For `core/blong-realm` it collapses to one participant, `blong->>blong`, because the
realm namespace is also `blong` - true, but the hop the artifact exists to show is no longer
visible. Options: leave it (honest, uninformative), or have each deployment name itself (e.g.
`log: {service: ...}` in the suite entry), which only renames the process and cannot separate two
components of one monolith. Needs the owner ruling, not a guess.
